The main takeaway from our work is that
MXD is a valuable proxy that captures temperature variability across a wide range of time scales.
MXD chronologies are more representative of large‐scale extratropical temperature variability and can be used to improve the understanding of the past and future climate.
MXD chronologies are better suited than TRW for reconstructing the full range of past temperature variability.
